items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: James Cagney was very famous for this. He would deliver a line and he would use his hands.

ctx.x: I really want to be one with the music, and hopefully the audience gets it.

Exactly, but you need to contact the audience with your eyes. Your eyes have a magnetism to them. A man has dominion over all the animals because of his eyes. A man can, through his eyes and the sound of his voice, tame any animal. A man should fear no animal. This is a natural fact. This is the story of Daniel in the lion’s den. Daniel had the gift of dream interpretation and dominion over animals. The lions came. Daniel looked at them and spoke to them, and they lay down. That’s why it’s necessary, like they…
So Charlie Parker – excuse me. So Art Tatum, his technique helped you to learn chord structures and also . . .
